prompt_verbatim: Create one complete animation frame for this exact pixel-art fighting-game character Ultraman Type C. It is the FIRST instant of a back-body-drop catch, immediately after his real descending upright pose in reference 1 (shown positioned on the monster in reference 2). Fixed side view, face and head to right. Keep his pelvis roughly where it was in the upright descending reference: do NOT instantly lift the hips forward or make him horizontally prone. His chest starts folding forward and down across the rounded upper back of the monster in reference 3; this is just the beginning of an involuntary fall over its back. Both knees begin bending and feet remain lower than in reference 4, which is a later pose, with a gradual intermediate action toward it. Head and neck stay to the left and above the monster's horn crown; both complete arms bend back beside ribs, fists away from the abdomen contact edge and horns. Use a generously tall canvas so no limbs are cut and do not shorten body or legs. Exactly two anatomically connected arms/hands and two legs/feet, red and silver pattern and blue light matching reference 5. Output ONLY the complete Ultraman character, not the monster or reference panels. No text, ground, shadow or additional objects. Coherent 2D pixel art, transparent background.
